{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I first tasted zoochberries while trading furbogs along the Corellian Run. Through these exchanges I ended up possessing any number of unusual items: hyperdrive attenuators, silicon-pronged tack trim, Sullustan gab-rippers and--you guessed it--more zoochberries than I knew what to do with (a single furbog is worth ten times its weight in zoochberries, after all)|Dexter Jettster on the acquiring Sullustan gab-rippers|<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Hyperdrive attenuators''' were items that were related to a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. While [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] was trading [[furbog]]s along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], he ended up with a number of unusual items including several  hyperdrive attenuators.<ref name="Menu" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> Jettster mentioned trading for the attenuators in the menu of his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hyperdrive attenuators were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
